name: jdm-legends-app
description: JDM LEGENDS — Web App full-stack: Node.js + TypeScript (Back-End) và React + TypeScript + Vite (Front-End)
author: Rinka-Mod

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c red,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
